title: Adds reason code for Issuing authorizations created while Stripe is unavailable
summary: Adds network_fallback as an option for the Issuing authorization object’s request_history.reason. Some users might be expecting a fixed set of options for the Issuing authorization object’s request_history.reason property. Update your code to expect this new option.

migrationNotes.text: You can now identify Issuing authorizations handled by the network when Stripe is unavailable.

sources.quote: | [Adds reason code for Issuing authorizations created while Stripe is unavailable](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-03-31/new-network-fallback-issuing-authorization-reason-code.md) | Issuing | Breaking | api |

Some users might be expecting a fixed set of options for the [Issuing authorization](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil) object’s [request_history.reason](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil#issuing_authorization_object-request_history-reason) property. Update your code to expect this new option.
